name: @urth/external-api-auth-plugin-sample
description: metatell CustomOverlay sample for external API authentication

scripts.build: pnpm run set-uuid && export $(cat .uuid.env) && webpack --mode production --config webpack.config.js && node ./scripts/add_metadata.js $VERSION_ID && node ./scripts/archive_dist.js
